key_points: S&P 500 fell 8.6% in the week of Nov 16-20 on AI-valuation and rate fears — the largest weekly rout in years, a real risk-off regime shift rather than single-name noise
Gold fell alongside equities (GLD -9.2%), so classic hedges did not work; correlation dynamics raise portfolio risk for a 60/40 holder
SPY saw a $1.53B outflow on Nov 19 with broad ETF net selling in mega-cap tech (MSFT, AMZN, GOOGL, META) — modest but directionally negative flow signal
Futures point to a rebound after the plunge and options volume is elevated, implying high near-term volatility rather than a resolved trend
Underlying driver is an AI-leadership scare (NVDA/China spy report, Trump comments) — a macro/sentiment shock that matters for index beta over weeks, but not a change to long-run SPY thesis
